title: GramproKit Passport Overlay v1
description: The authored half of a component passport: passport.manual.json, written by the library, and passport.local.json, owned by the consuming developer. An overlay is a partial — the generator supplies passportVersion, identity, source, props, events, slots, states and coverage from the TypeScript, and merging the two produces passport.json, which passport-v1.schema.json describes. Validating an overlay against that schema reports all eight generated fields as missing and rejects the keys only an overlay has, which is why this file exists.

component.description: Which component this annotates. Checked against the folder it sits in.

props.description: Annotations for derived props, by name: a description, a note or a deprecation. Only passport.local.json may introduce a prop that is not in the source.

propNotes.description: Shorthand for annotating derived props: a map of prop name to note. Every key must name a prop the source actually has.

notImplemented.description: Capabilities a reader might reasonably expect and this component does not have. Saying so is cheaper than an agent discovering it by writing code that cannot work.

$operationsNote.description: Where the operations block is mirrored from, and what fails if the two drift.
